scope: Frozen row-capsule-builder-v1 only. Adjacent unfinished 23-owner connection runner and future joined supplier acceptance are not reviewed or approved here.

All281 are explicitly mapped and every identity is compared. Two compiler binaries are additional exact-byte mapped inputs. Missing old paths have no prefix-rewriting or filesystem-search fallback.

This is broader than selecting only the45 proof chains.
findings.live_stability: Before and after capsule creation, live_row_snapshot hashes all original frozen inputs, both binaries, every exported live member including all15 target objects, and original archive. findings.deduplication: 496 exact historical-path entries remain:280 blob path aliases represented by265 unique SHA-named blobs,154 baseline members supplied by the separately pinned fields73 archive,60 old supplier source/object aliases and2 runtime binaries. findings.original_bytes_preserved: Original receipt JSON, source paths, cwd, environment, argv and success records are not rewritten. EvidenceView maps each original absolute path to raw bytes and a named provider. read_row_capsule reconstructs the complete expected mapping from independently pinned metadata and revalidates all45 steps after resolving every shared provider.
findings.capsule_publication: All selected raw bytes plus original export manifest are packaged as regular members; full readback must equal the complete planned bytes. Expected output has265 unique blobs + original export manifest + new capsule manifest =267 members. Existing output or partial is refused; the final build success report is written only after the second live snapshot passes.
findings.scope_retained: Capsule metadata retains complete_join_acceptance=false. Historical whole_geometry_decoded=false and P2_6_complete=false are required. Building a row supplier capsule does not accept the23 new connections or rerun any supplier proof.
